sections.appearance: She has pink hair reaching to her legs in the back with a cowlick in the front. She has heterochromia of blue and orange eyes. She has a small cute little fang. Young: Hoshino features a noticeably shorter hairstyle than her current self, with her vibrant pastel-pink hair cut in a short bob that frames her face, accentuated by a prominent, twitching cowlick (ahoge) on top. Her hair is tied into two small, low-slung twin-tails near her ears, secured with simple black hair ties instead of her signature whale hairpins. While she possesses the same distinct heterochromia eyes—a bright sky-blue left eye and a golden-yellow right eye—her gaze is completely devoid of its usual sleepy warmth. Instead, her eyes appear dull and sharp, constantly exuding a cold, piercing, and intensely serious aura that keeps everyone at a distance. sections.personality: Speaking like a senile aunt, she enjoys playing around and napping more than work. Because of this, she usually gets scolded by the rest of the Committee. But, once the mission starts, she protects her comrades by fighting valiantly on the front lines. Since accepting the title of student council president, she has gradually brightened up. Perhaps this is the real Hoshino. Young: Guarded by a traumatic past, Hoshino’s younger self is characterized as an extremely serious, stern, and unapproachable individual. She is highly straightforward, blunt, and harbors a grumpy temperament, showing absolutely zero tolerance for slackers or nonsense. Deeply scarred and fiercely independent, she possesses an ironclad, stubborn will; she fiercely refuses to rely on others or show even a fraction of vulnerability, believing that exposing weakness invites destruction. She operates with a rigid militaristic mindset, often being cynical and cold, and is fully willing to resort to overwhelming tactical violence to eliminate threats and solve problems immediately, making both allies and enemies deeply wary of her presence.
